# Slug collisions resolved with deterministic suffix

When two entities slugify to the same base name, normalization appends a deterministic numeric suffix to resolve the collision, resulting in multiple similarly-named slugs that downstream systems must handle.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_normalize.py` — `tests.test_normalize.test_slug_collision_gets_deterministic_suffix`
